checkoutExpiryHours.title: Unpaid checkout expires after (hours)
checkoutExpiryHours.description: How long a payer has to finish paying on the gateway's page, for gateways that take a time limit (Stripe at most 24 hours, JazzCash and Easypaisa at most 168); each gateway's own longest caps it. A payer who comes back later starts a new checkout from the pay page.
